verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state firewall is enabled by default blocking all incoming traffic except SSH and LocalSend ports, requiring no manual setup. There is also mention of security concerns (bash injection vulnerabilities) in community threads, but no evidence specifically contradicts the firewall default. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that the firewall is actually active out-of-the-box and details on how it's implemented (e.g., ufw/iptables rules).
